root_cause: Repository Writer Candidate Shadow had a global pull_request trigger even though its job only admitted writer/* branches. Ordinary PRs therefore allocated a workflow run that immediately skipped. Four writer producers also depended on that global trigger instead of explicit immutable dispatch.
prevention: Make Shadow workflow_dispatch-only. Require every writer producer to dispatch exact PR/base/head/ref identity explicitly; centralize missing writer paths through one bounded helper and regression-test all seven writers.
